claim: On April 05, 2023 the documentation history added the default quota of 1000 for open Map Runs in each account. The service quotas table in the AWS General Reference lists Open Map Runs as not adjustable.

evidence.quote: | Quota update | Added information about default quota of 1000 for open Map Runs in each account. For more information, see [Quotas related to accounts](service-quotas.md#service-limits-accounts). | April 05, 2023 |
|  Open Map Runs | Each supported Region: 1,000 | No | The maximum number of open Map Runs allowed at a time in this account. |
